description: This file defines API route handlers for note-related operations in a FastAPI application. It includes functions for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions.

methods.name: list_notes( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search query to filter notes by title"), archived: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="Filter by archived status"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list notes with optional search by title and filtering by archived status.

methods.name: get_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: create_note(payload: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note.

methods.name: update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing note by ID.

methods.name: delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a note by ID.
